secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side admin operations (bypasses RLS). Obtain from the Supabase dashboard → Settings → API → service_role key. Not required to boot — only needed for /admin routes.

secrets.name: LOVABLE_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the Lovable AI Gateway used by the /ai chat feature. Obtain from Lovable Cloud. Not required to boot — only needed for AI chat server functions.
